_readme: MarketCentaur Studio: done-for-you AI services for individuals and families. Edit this file, then run `node scripts/build-studio.mjs` from the repo root. Never add prices here: quotes are emailed after a brief is sent (see content/studio/README.md). Field types: text, email, tel, url, date, textarea, select, checkboxes.

offers.name: Personalised occasion videos
offers.headline: Personalised videos for weddings, birthdays and the moments that matter
offers.title: Personalised Occasion Videos: Invites, Birthdays, Tributes
offers.description: Wedding invites, save-the-dates, birthday surprises, anniversary films and tributes from your photos and story, in your language. Get a quote.
offers.lead: Send us your photos, names, dates and the feeling you want. We turn them into a polished video invite, greeting or tribute, ready to share on WhatsApp, Instagram or a big screen.
offers.card: Wedding invites, save-the-dates, birthday and anniversary films, tributes and announcements, from your photos and story.
gets: A finished video in vertical (for WhatsApp and Reels) or landscape (for screens and YouTube) format, or both
Your names, dates, venue details and message, with titles in the language or languages you choose
Licensed background music and a style that fits the occasion, from traditional to modern
One round of changes after you see the first version
Optional extras: a short teaser cut, a still image card for printing or sharing, extra language versions
goodFor: Wedding invites and save-the-dates, including multi-event and multi-language weddings
Birthday surprises, milestone birthdays and anniversaries
Baby announcements, naming ceremonies, housewarmings and festival greetings
Retirement, farewell and memorial tributes, made with care
steps: Send the brief
Tell us the occasion, date, names, language and style. Share a link to your photos and clips.
Get your quote
We email a quote with the price, delivery time and secure payment options.
Review and share
We send a first version for review, make your changes, and deliver the final files.
offers.needs: Photos or short clips in a shared folder (Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox or iCloud link), the exact text you want on screen, and any must-have details such as venue, timings or RSVP contacts.

fields.name: languages
fields.label: Language or languages on screen
fields.placeholder: e.g. English and Marathi

fields.name: names_and_details
fields.label: Names, dates, venue and text to show
fields.placeholder: Names as they should appear, event dates and times, venue, RSVP contacts, a message or quote

fields.name: mood
fields.label: Style and mood
fields.placeholder: e.g. traditional and elegant, fun and colourful, calm and respectful

fields.name: media_link
fields.label: Link to your photos or clips (optional)
fields.placeholder: Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox or iCloud link

faq: Can you make the video in more than one language?
Yes. Tell us the languages in the brief. We can put several languages in one video or make a separate version for each, and the quote will reflect what you choose.
What music do you use?
We use licensed music from stock libraries so your video can be shared safely. We can't use film songs or other copyrighted tracks, but we will match the mood you ask for.
Can you make a tribute for someone who has passed away?
Yes. We handle memorial videos with care, keep the tone respectful, and share the draft privately with you before anything is final.
What if I need it urgently?
Put the real date in the brief. If we can meet it, the quote will say so; if we can't, we'll tell you before you pay.

offers.name: Career makeover
offers.headline: A resume, LinkedIn profile and cover letter that get you to the interview
offers.title: Career Makeover: Resume, LinkedIn Profile and Cover Letter
offers.description: Resume rewrites, LinkedIn makeovers, cover letters and portfolio pages, tailored to the roles and countries you want. Send a brief for a quote.
offers.lead: Send us your current CV and the roles you want next. We rewrite your resume, LinkedIn profile and cover letter around your real achievements and the words recruiters and screening software look for.
offers.card: Resume rewrite, LinkedIn profile makeover, cover letters and a simple portfolio page, aimed at the roles you want.
gets: A rewritten resume in an ATS-friendly layout (Word and PDF), built around your real results
LinkedIn headline, About section, experience entries and skills, ready to paste in
A cover letter template you can adapt for each application
Optional: a one-page portfolio or personal website with your work samples
Optional: versions for a second target role or country, and interview talking points
goodFor: Job seekers changing roles, industries or countries
Graduates and early-career professionals writing a first serious CV
Professionals returning to work after a break
Freelancers and consultants who need a profile that wins clients
steps: Send the brief
Tell us the roles, industries and countries you're targeting and share your current CV and LinkedIn link.
Get your quote
We email a quote with the price, delivery time and secure payment options.
Review and apply
We send the first drafts, make one round of changes, and hand over the final files.

fields.name: target_roles
fields.label: Target roles and industries
fields.placeholder: e.g. Product marketing manager, SaaS

fields.name: target_countries
fields.label: Countries you're applying in
fields.placeholder: e.g. India, UAE, UK

fields.name: linkedin_url
fields.label: LinkedIn profile URL (optional)
fields.placeholder: https://www.linkedin.com/in/...

fields.name: cv_link
fields.label: Link to your current CV (optional)
fields.placeholder: Google Drive, OneDrive or Dropbox link

faq: Will the resume pass applicant tracking systems?

We use a clean, single-column layout and the keywords from the job ads you share, which is what screening software reads best. No one can guarantee a shortlist, but we remove the common formatting problems that get CVs filtered out.
Do you invent experience or skills?
No. Everything in your resume and profile is based on what you've actually done. We help you describe it clearly and measure it where you can.
Can you write for jobs abroad?
Yes. Tell us the countries and we'll follow the conventions there, for example CV length, photos and personal details.
Is my CV kept private?
Yes. We use your documents only to do the work and you can ask us to delete them once it's delivered. See our privacy policy for details.

faq: Will you change how I look in photos?
No. We improve lighting, colour, sharpness and backgrounds so the photos look like you on a good day. We don't change faces or body shape, and we won't make photos that misrepresent you.
Can I order a profile for my son, daughter or sibling?
Yes, as long as they know about it and agree. We write from the details you share and the final text should be checked by them.
Can you write in Indian languages?
Yes. Tell us the language in the brief and we'll confirm in the quote.
Will you write anything untrue?
No. A good profile is honest. We help you present real details warmly and clearly.

offers.name: Personalised astrology reports
offers.headline: Personalised Vedic astrology reports and video horoscopes, explained in plain words
offers.title: Personalised Vedic Astrology Reports and Video Horoscopes
offers.description: Kundli summaries, compatibility reports, yearly outlooks and video horoscopes from Vedic (Jyotish) charts, in plain words. Send a brief for a quote.
offers.lead: Share your birth details and what you'd like to understand. We prepare a clear, personalised report from your Vedic chart, in your language, as a PDF or a short narrated video.
offers.card: Kundli summaries, compatibility reports, yearly outlooks and personal video horoscopes, in plain words.
gets: A personalised report based on your Vedic (Jyotish) birth chart, written in plain language
Your choice of a designed PDF, a short narrated video, or both
Reports in English or another language you choose
Optional: a compatibility report for two people, or a monthly video horoscope
goodFor: Kundli (birth chart) summaries for yourself or a newborn
Compatibility reports before marriage, alongside family discussions
Yearly outlooks around birthdays or the new year
Gifts for parents and grandparents, in their language
steps: Send the brief
Choose the report and share the date, time and place of birth, and the language you'd like.
Get your quote
We email a quote with the price, delivery time and secure payment options.
Receive your report
We prepare your chart and report and send the PDF or video to your email.
offers.needs: Date of birth, the most accurate time of birth you have, and the town or city of birth for each person, plus the questions or areas you'd like the report to cover.

fields.name: birth_details
fields.label: Birth details
fields.placeholder: For each person: name, date of birth, time of birth (as exact as possible), town or city of birth

fields.name: focus
fields.label: What would you like the report to cover? (optional)
fields.placeholder: e.g. career, relationships, the year ahead

fields.name: report_language
fields.label: Language
fields.placeholder: e.g. English, Hindi, Marathi, Tamil

faq: How should I use the report?

Astrology reports are for reflection, tradition and personal interest. They are not medical, financial, legal or psychological advice, and important decisions should be made with the right professional and the people involved.
Which system do you use?
Reports are based on Vedic (Jyotish) charts calculated from your birth date, time and place, and explained in plain words.
What if I don't know my exact time of birth?
Give us the closest time you know and tell us how sure you are. Some parts of the chart depend on the time, and the report will say where that matters.
Are my birth details kept private?
Yes. We use them only to prepare your report and you can ask us to delete them afterwards.

offers.name: Done-for-you creator channels

offers.description: YouTube and Instagram channels set up and produced for you: niche research, branding, scripts and AI-assisted videos. Send a brief for a quote.
offers.lead: Pick a topic you care about. We research the niche, brand the channel, and produce videos and Shorts for you each week, so you can build an audience without learning editing software.
offers.card: YouTube and Instagram channels set up and produced for you: niche research, branding, scripts and weekly videos.
gets: Niche and topic research, with a list of video ideas people are searching for
Channel setup and branding: name ideas, logo, banner, profile and descriptions
Scripts and AI-assisted videos (landscape and Shorts or Reels), produced and checked by a person
Titles, descriptions, thumbnails and a posting calendar
Ongoing monthly production if you want it, with a simple monthly report

Teachers, coaches and experts who want to share knowledge on video
Families and hobbyists building a channel in their own language
Small creators who want to post more often

Tell us the platform, topic, language and how often you'd like to post.
Get your quote

Launch and grow
We set up the channel, deliver the first videos for your approval, and keep producing on the agreed schedule.

fields.name: channel_language
fields.label: Language

fields.name: presence
fields.label: How do you want to appear?

faq: Can you guarantee views or income?
No. Growth depends on the topic, consistency, the platform and many things nobody controls. We focus on doing the parts that are in our hands well: research, quality, consistency and clear reporting.
Do you follow platform rules on AI content?
Yes. We follow YouTube and Meta rules, including labelling realistic AI-generated content where the platform requires it, and we use licensed music and footage.
Who owns the channel?
You do. The channel is created in your account and you keep all logins. We work with the access you give us and you can remove it at any time.
Can I pause or stop monthly production?
Yes. Monthly production runs month to month and can be paused or stopped with notice before the next month starts.

offers.lead: AI assistants can save hours a week, but setting them up is fiddly. We configure the right tools on your phone and computer, connect them to your email and calendar if you want, and show you how to use them safely.
offers.card: AI assistants set up for you or your parents: email, calendar, reminders, travel, documents and safe habits.
gets: A short call to understand your day and what you'd like help with
Setup of one or two AI assistants on your phone and computer, with privacy settings checked
Ready-made instructions and shortcuts for your common tasks (emails, planning, travel, documents, learning)
A guided session (online, screen share) and a one-page cheat sheet in your language
Optional: a separate, simpler setup for parents or older family members, with safety tips on scams and deepfakes
goodFor: Busy professionals who want help with email, planning and documents
Parents juggling school, household and work schedules
Older adults who want to use AI with confidence and stay safe online
Students who want to study with AI the right way
steps: Send the brief
Tell us who it's for, the devices you use and what you'd like help with.
Get your quote
We email a quote with the price, session options and secure payment options.
Set up together
We set everything up with you over a screen-share session and send your cheat sheet.
offers.needs: The devices you use (iPhone, Android, Windows, Mac), the email and calendar you use, the tasks you'd like help with, and any accounts or subscriptions you already have.

fields.name: help_with
fields.label: What would you like help with?

fields.name: current_tools
fields.label: AI tools you already use (optional)
fields.placeholder: e.g. ChatGPT free, Gemini, none yet

fields.name: session_language
fields.label: Language for the session
fields.placeholder: e.g. English, Hindi

faq: Do I need to pay for AI subscriptions?
Not always. Many tasks work on free plans. If a paid plan would help, we'll explain the options and you decide; you pay the provider directly.
Do you need my passwords?
No. We guide you to sign in yourself during the session. We never ask you to send passwords by email or chat.
Is it safe to connect AI to my email?
It can be, with the right settings. We explain what each connection can see, switch on the privacy options available, and leave out anything you're not comfortable with.
Can you help my parents in another city?
Yes. Sessions are online, so we can help family members anywhere, at a time that suits them.

faq: Do I need a domain name?
Not to start. We can publish your one-page site on a free address, or set it up on your own domain if you buy one; we'll explain the options in the quote.
Who owns the website and profiles?
You do. Everything is set up in your name and accounts, and we hand over all files and logins.
Can you help me later with more?
Yes. Once you're up and running, you can order more posts, updates or a bigger website at any time.
I run a registered business with staff. Is this for me?
Our business services may suit you better. See the main MarketCentaur services for websites, AI front desks and content.

Some are ready and some are in production. When you send the form we'll email the price and payment link for what's ready, and add you to early access for the rest.
Do I need a paid AI plan for the prompt packs?
No. The prompts work with the free plans of the main AI assistants.
Can I share the templates?

What if a file doesn't work for me?
Reply to your delivery email and we'll help you get it working or fix the file.

Revision notes and summaries for the subjects and chapters you choose
Practice question sets with worked answers, in the style of the exam
Optional: short revision videos and a weekly check-in plan

College students and adult learners preparing for university or professional exams
Competitive exam aspirants who need a structured revision plan
Parents who want a clear plan to support their child

Tell us the exam, board or syllabus, the subjects, the exam date and the language.
Get your quote
We email a quote with the price, delivery time and secure payment options.
Study

faq: Can students under 18 order?
Orders for students under 18 must be placed by a parent or guardian, who receives the quote and the materials.
Are the notes accurate?
Notes and questions are prepared with AI tools from the syllabus and checked by a person before delivery. Always use the official syllabus and the school's or exam body's guidance as the final word.
Is this a replacement for a teacher?
No. The pack gives structure and practice alongside teachers, classes and textbooks.
Can you include past-paper practice?
We write practice questions in the style of the exam. We don't copy questions from copyrighted papers or books, but we can point you to official sample papers where they exist.
